title: Conditions to check for Your First Sync

question.author: member_117
question.body: Could support clarify your first sync in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Getting Started documentation says: After signing in to a desktop client, CloudBox creates a local CloudBox folder. Anything you put inside it syncs to the cloud and to your other devices; anything you put in the cloud appears in the folder. The tray icon shows sync state: green when up to date, spinning blue while syncing, red on errors. Right-click the icon to pause, open preferences, or check sync activity. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
